name: Kanikka Kapur
bio: Kanikka Kapur is an Indian model and actor. She appeared in the Sony TV’s serial ‘Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2’ in 2020 and India's next Superstar.

credits.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
credits.overview: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

credits.title: Batwara 1947
credits.overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

credits.title: Murderbaad
credits.overview: A Jaipur tour guide's romance with an NRI unravels when a fellow tourist goes missing. As suspicion mounts, he vanishes-sparking a nationwide hunt that leads to one of modern India's most shocking crime twists.

credits.title: Dono
credits.overview: The film explores modern relationships and is set against the backdrop of a lavish destination wedding.
